Chapter 7074: Curse Of Creation

Chapter 7074: Curse of Creation

As the process accelerated, it became connected to his body, forcing him to spend his life and vitality to fuel the endless growth.

“Curse of Creation.” Someone said: “Using the versions of Mortal World as a medium to curse him.”

Now the attackers’ purpose became clear. This curse would only stop after depleting Li Qiye’s life and blood.

“Only a few are qualified to be cursed like this.” One spectator said.

In Heavenrealm, few immortals had enough power to fuel the process until it became unstoppable. A weak immortal could only fuel it for a few seconds before extinguishing.

“Is this ever going to stop?” Someone said.

The crowd was in awe at both the frightening curse and Li Qiye’s seemingly endless vitality. The latter showed no sign of letting up.

The stars and firmaments didn’t deplete his energy to the attackers’ dismay. They had used the same thing on the enforcer and saw how it withered her down.

“Impossible!” The celestial immortals shouted.

“Faster!” They chanted faster to release more laws, doubling the speed.

Now, Li Qiye created firmaments with a single thought, not just with each breath. It expended more life and vitality than ever.

Unfortunately, he still looked to be in a perfect state. All of the creation somehow only used a drop of blood.

Previously, it weakened the enforcer, allowing them to suppress her temporarily. How was this not effective against Li Qiye?

“If this is your ace card, it’s too weak.” Li Qiye smiled, not anxious in the slightest regarding his vitality usage.

Their expression became ugly due to the unexpected failure.

“Just you watch!” Heavenly Whale shouted: “Ocean, rise!”

The radiant platform became the center of the ocean, spinning and sucking in the tribulations.

“Return!” Demise and the others helped the process, pulling in the newly created universe into the ocean.

The only thing unaffected by the pull was Li Qiye, the new universe’s creator.

“Don’t get close!” Spectators in Ruin became afraid.

“Boom!” The platform finished taking in the tribulation ocean and the new worlds created from the curse.

Its slightest movement shook Heavenrealm violently.

“What is happening?” Those outside shuddered in fear. Despite its ordinary appearance, the platform could start absorbing all of Heavenrealm’s power.
